changes.new: ### Computing a Gated DeltaNet block The token loop first decays the state, then predicts the current value and writes a correction. Computing every correction from the same block-start state would omit earlier writes. Unlike the TTT mini-batch rule below, the chunkwise Gated DeltaNet operator preserves the token-by-token update. Within one block, number positions $r=1,\ldots,b$ and let $S_0$ be the incoming key-by-value state. Write the correction as a value vector $u_r$: $$ \begin{aligned} u_r&=\beta_r(v_r-\gamma_rS_{r-1}^{\top}k_r),\\ S_r&=\gamma_rS_{r-1}+k_ru_r^{\top}. \end{aligned} $$ Define $\lambda_r=\prod_{j=1}^r\gamma_j$ and $D_{ri}=\prod_{j=i+1}^r\gamma_j$ for $i\le r$, with zero entries above the diagonal.
